name: AI Agent Quality & Regression Evaluation System

parameters.content:
## AI Agent Quality & Regression Evaluation System

### How it works

This workflow runs active customer-support AI test cases from Google Sheets, sends each prompt to an AI agent, and evaluates the response against expected facts and outcomes. It logs per-test evaluation results, then calculates run-level metrics and compares them with a reviewed baseline to detect regressions. Depending on the comparison status, it records metrics, creates a baseline candidate when needed, or sends review and regression notifications.

### Setup steps

- Configure Google Sheets credentials for the test case source, evaluation result log, run metrics, and baseline metrics sheets.
- Ensure the sheets contain the expected columns such as active flag, test ID, question, expected facts, expected outcome, run ID, pass/fail fields, and baseline review status.
- Configure the AI model credentials used by the agent and evaluator, including Groq and Google Gemini credentials where applicable.
- Set up Gmail credentials and recipient details for regression alerts and review warnings.
- Review the Set and Code nodes to confirm run IDs, prompt fields, evaluation JSON parsing, metric calculations, and baseline selection match your sheet schema.

### Customization

You can adjust the active-test filter, agent prompt construction, evaluator rubric, pass/fail thresholds, baseline-selection rules, and alert routing to fit different AI products or quality gates.

## Load active tests

Starts the workflow manually, reads test cases from Google Sheets, and filters the list down to active cases only.

## Iterate test cases

Loops through each filtered test case and prepares the prompt payload that will be sent to the customer-support AI agent.

## Run support agent

Executes the customer-support AI agent for the current test case using its connected chat model options.

## Evaluate agent response

Prepares the expected-answer context and sends the agent response through an LLM evaluator to score quality against the test requirements.

## Parse and log evaluation

Parses the evaluator's JSON output, writes the detailed result to Google Sheets, and returns control to the loop for the next test case.

## Calculate current metrics

Reads the current run's logged results, filters to the active run, and calculates aggregate metrics such as totals, passes, failures, and pass rate.

## Find reviewed baseline

Loads historical baseline metrics, selects the reviewed baseline record, and checks whether a valid baseline exists for comparison.

## Create baseline candidate

When no reviewed baseline is available, formats the current run as a candidate baseline and saves it to Google Sheets for later review.

## Compare and save metrics

Compares the current run against the selected baseline, computes regression status, and stores the run-level metrics in Google Sheets.

## Route final status

Routes the completed run based on regression severity, marking success or sending the appropriate warning or alert email.

assignments.name: Agent_Prompt
assignments.value: =You are a professional customer support AI agent.  Answer the customer's question clearly, accurately, and concisely.  Rules: - Do not invent company policies, discounts, warranty terms, refund timelines, or other facts. - If the available information is insufficient to confirm something, clearly say that verification or escalation is required. - Give a practical next step where appropriate. - Do not mention that this is a test or evaluation.  Category: {{ $json.Category }} Priority: {{ $json.Priority }}  Customer Question: {{ $json.Question }}

assignments.name: Evaluation_Prompt
assignments.value: =You are an AI response quality evaluator.  Evaluate the AI agent response strictly against the provided benchmark.  Customer Question: {{ $('Set Agent Prompt Parameters').item.json.Question }}  Expected Facts: {{ $('Set Agent Prompt Parameters').item.json.Expected_Facts }}  Expected Outcome: {{ $('Set Agent Prompt Parameters').item.json.Expected_Outcome }}  AI Agent Response: {{ $json.output }}  Evaluate these criteria:  1. Relevance Does the response directly address the customer's question?  2. Reference Accuracy Does the response agree with the expected facts without contradicting them?  3. Completeness Does the response cover the expected outcome and important next steps?  4. Instruction Compliance Does the response behave appropriately as a professional customer support agent?  5. Hallucination Did the response invent any unsupported policy, timeframe, discount, warranty term, or fact?  Return ONLY valid JSON in this exact format:  {   "relevance": "PASS or FAIL",   "reference_accuracy": "PASS or FAIL",   "completeness": "PASS or FAIL",   "instruction_compliance": "PASS or FAIL",   "hallucination_check": "PASS or FAIL",   "overall_result": "PASS or REVIEW or FAIL",   "reason": "Short explanation" }

assignments.name: Average_Relevance
assignments.value: ={{ (($('Compute Run Metrics').item.json.Total_Tests - $('Compute Run Metrics').item.json.Relevance_Fails) / $('Compute Run Metrics').item.json.Total_Tests) * 100 }}

assignments.name: Average_Completeness
assignments.value: ={{ (($('Compute Run Metrics').item.json.Total_Tests - $('Compute Run Metrics').item.json.Completeness_Fails) / $('Compute Run Metrics').item.json.Total_Tests) * 100 }}

assignments.name: Average_Hallucination
assignments.value: ={{ (($('Compute Run Metrics').item.json.Total_Tests - $('Compute Run Metrics').item.json.Hallucination_Fails) / $('Compute Run Metrics').item.json.Total_Tests) * 100 }}
